title: Robert D NDE 4929
content: I was at a friend's barbeque with a few friends. I was eating when I must have inhaled a tiny speck of chip. I immediately realized it went down wrong and with what food still in my mouth I spit it out. However, it did not help I was still losing air and it seemed the flap was beginning to close tighter. I had several people try the Heimlich and hit spots on my back but nothing was happening. I felt panicked scared, frightened, as I saw everyone had a look on their face as if they were helpless. After about two to three minutes, I finally gave out and collapsed to my knees. At that point, I realized it was useless to fight and was accepting what was to be. At that very moment, I was no longer present in the room. I felt this warmth. I was no longer afraid. I was feeling the undiluted, most-perfect form of peace. Then I was seeing myself in an embryo state positioned over earth looking back at it. It was as if I was looking at myself but at the same time, I knew it was me. I was no longer afraid of the space or the emptiness. Rather, it was the exact opposite. I was calm, reassured, and I was willing to stay there with no regards to any earthly reason to return. It is at that very moment I heard this powerful, serene, caring, authoritative, loving male voice say to me, 'It is not your time, have someone hit you in the lower left area of your back'. Instantly, I was back in the room with everyone standing around me and I motioned for someone to hit me in the area I was told. Someone did what I asked and my breathing released but it was still laborious to get air in still wheezing and whistling, it took about five minutes to regain breathing.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "powerful, serene, caring, authoritative, loving male voice" spoke: "It is not your time, have someone hit you in the lower left area of your back".

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as "space or the emptiness"; also described being "positioned over earth looking back at it".

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Choking on a tiny speck of chip/food obstruction at a barbeque; unable to breathe despite Heimlich attempts.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described being "positioned over earth looking back at it" and hearing a loving male voice give instructions to restore breathing.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like shift from the room directly into a peaceful state "over earth" with a disembodied voice; no tunnel/light/life review described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived self "in an embryo state positioned over earth looking back at it"; specific medical instruction given: "have someone hit you in the lower left area of your back" leading to breathing release.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was feeling the undiluted, most-perfect form of peace." / "It is not your time, have someone hit you in the lower left area of your back".
